newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes flat in range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes flat in range-bound trade.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed steady against the dollar on Wednesday, dealers said.
The rupee closed at its opening level of 58.72 to the dollar, after rising to 58.65 and falling to 58.75, they said.
"There were speculators on both sides," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer. "Buyers used low call rates to stock up on dollars and sellers thought anything over 58.70 was a good price."
"Banks which went short on dollars when overnight money went to over 17 percent last week, covered positions using low call rates," said an ABN Amro Bank dealer.
Call money closed at 9.75 percent, after opening at 10 percent, dealers said.
